subject: exp-dy
title: EXP.DY.------ALT.C.PROG.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 494 (TRF(II)-30). EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the subject; ALT-C-PROG is the partner. From the subject: EXT-F (extended functionalism), POL-DY (political dynamics) and INFO-DY. From EXT-F: WO-UNF (world unification). From POL-DY: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From EXB-H-OR: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From PHY-U-C: SOC-PG. From INFO-DY: PER-DY (perception dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: HI-P (high purpose).
